name: pnp-copilot-pro-dev-da-azure-devops-wiki
title: Azure DevOps Wiki Assistant
shortDescription: A read-only declarative agent that answers questions from your Azure DevOps Wiki with citations, and says when an answer isn't in the wiki.
longDescription: A read-only Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agent grounded strictly on the Azure DevOps Wiki Copilot connector. It searches indexed project and code wikis, preserves the guide's numbered steps and reference tables, cites the source page, and clearly states when an answer is not found in the wiki instead of answering from general knowledge. Built with TypeSpec and the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit, it binds to the connector as its only knowledge source and retargets tenants through a single environment variable.
